title: pasania glaberrima
intro: Pasania glaberrima, commonly known as Pasania, is a plant species belonging to the family Lauraceae. Pasania glaberrima has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pasania glaberrima include its antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it useful in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents present in Pasania glaberrima include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
